hyperedges.label: Excel Styling Extraction and Rendering Pipeline

nodes.label: Duplicate SRD Creation Bug Fix
nodes.rationale: Used useRef guard to prevent React Strict Mode double-rendering causing duplicate API calls

nodes.label: relevantEntries Variable Fix
nodes.rationale: Variable relevantEntries was used without being defined; fix adds proper filtering of SRD status array by relevant departments

nodes.label: checkAndAutoApproveDepartments Not Defined Fix
nodes.rationale: Removed unnecessary timeout-based auto-approval check; auto-approval now only happens on save for more predictable UX

nodes.label: SRD Progress Calculation
nodes.rationale: Progress is calculated as (approved departments / total relevant departments) * 100; readyForProduction is true only when all 4 departments are approved

nodes.label: Configurable Auto-Approval Threshold
nodes.rationale: Per-department threshold overrides allow fine-grained control; global default is 80% but each department (vmd, cad, commercial, mmc) can have independent thresholds

nodes.label: SheetJS (xlsx) Library
nodes.rationale: Replaced Google Docs Viewer with client-side SheetJS parsing to enable localhost support, offline operation, and editing capabilities

nodes.label: Department Background Color Removal
nodes.rationale: Replaced colored department backgrounds (gray, amber, emerald, sky) with uniform white for cleaner readability and professional appearance

nodes.label: Real-time Auto-Approval Enhancement
nodes.rationale: Added debounced (1 second) auto-approval check after each field change so users get instant feedback without requiring manual Save

nodes.label: Desktop-Mobile API Unification
nodes.rationale: Desktop used strict sequential /production/complete-stage while mobile used flexible /sample-process endpoint; unified to use sample-process for both to match real-world workflow where stages may overlap

nodes.label: Brand Field Debounce Optimization
nodes.rationale: useEffect watched entire dynamicFields array causing API calls on every keystroke; optimized to watch only Brand field value with 500ms debounce to eliminate lag

nodes.label: Dispatch Button Visibility Fix
nodes.rationale: Buttons required DispatchDetails object (only created on image upload); changed to show buttons when ANY dispatch detail field has a value

nodes.label: Google Docs Viewer Replacement
nodes.rationale: Google Docs Viewer cannot access localhost URLs, requires internet, is slow, and has no editing; replaced with client-side SheetJS parsing for offline, fast, editable Excel viewing

nodes.label: Handsontable CSS Import Fix
nodes.rationale: Was importing .js file instead of .css for Handsontable theme; fixed to import handsontable.min.css and ht-theme-main.min.css

nodes.label: Handsontable Destroyed Instance Guard
nodes.rationale: Added isDestroyed check before calling hot.render() to prevent runtime error on destroyed Handsontable instances

nodes.label: CSS Custom Properties Font System
nodes.rationale: Centralized font sizing via CSS variables (--font-size-heading: 11px, --font-size-text: 9px) replacing scattered Tailwind classes across 60+ files for single-point control
